polity.canonical_name_en: Government-in-exile of the Ukrainian People's Republic

activity.notes: After the Ukrainian People's Republic lost territorial control in late 1920, Petliura continued as head of the Directory and therefore head of the UNR government-in-exile until his death on 25 May 1926. ATLAS keeps this exile phase separate from his territorial-state leadership.

sources.title: Encyclopedia of Ukraine — Government-in-exile of the Ukrainian National Republic
sources.citation_text: The Encyclopedia of Ukraine states that Symon Petliura remained head of the Directory and hence head of state until 25 May 1926.

sources.title: State Archival Service of Ukraine — The Odyssey of the Petliura Library and the Records of the Ukrainian National Republic during World War II
sources.citation_text: Ukraine's archival service describes the UNR government being forced into exile in 1920 and Petliura initially settling in Tarnów as chairman of the UNR Directorate.
